page.notes: Printing faults kept as printed: "versionisSamaritanæ", "pluresSamaritanorum", "siclos,eosque" run together without spaces. The Greek word after "Pω-" is uncertain in its accents. "Perescius" is read from a blurred name and is uncertain. "qvám" is printed with a u-form and is transcribed as quám. The left-margin fragments are edge of the neighbouring page and are not transcribed.
